'''Holographic lamps''' were illumination devices that gave off a dim light. [[Tyro Viveca/Legends|Tyro Viveca]] had holographic lamps in his [[Tyro Viveca's estate|estate]], installed in an octagonal room that held trophies of the [[Krish (species)/Legends|Krish's]] kills.<ref name="FP">{{GamerCite|1|Fair Prey}}</ref>
